prerequisites.label: python3 on PATH (the interpreter the Launcher and its verify.sh run under)
prerequisites.satisfy: Install Python 3. Mac: brew install python@3.12. VPS: ships in the container image.

prerequisites.label: Python package jsonschema>=4.0 importable by python3 with the shared pydeps folder first on sys.path (the Skill 79 checkout validator imports it at module load; Skills 49, 71, 78-82, 44 and 38 reach it too)
prerequisites.satisfy: Installed into the private pydeps folder (<root>/pydeps/py<X.Y>/, or the folder OC_PYDEPS_DIR names, used as-is) with pip --target, the one install an externally-managed Python accepts, by the onboarding installer and updater (oc_ensure_jsonschema in lib-onboarding-state.sh) or by 999's setup script (ensure_jsonschema); the launcher also repairs it itself before it builds anything. Never --break-system-packages, never a venv. Check with: python3 -m launcher_core.cli dependencies (run from the 83-black-friday-launcher folder; the runtime-jsonschema row), or bash update-skills.sh --prereqs-check on an onboarding box. To install by hand: python3 -m launcher_core.cli dependencies --install. This entry's pythonModule and requirement keys are what oc_ensure_jsonschema reads.
